# pqblocks-cnsa2-pki-auditor

X.509 certificate estate compliance auditor enforcing NSA CNSA 2.0 and NIST FIPS 203/204/205 post-quantum standards with SARIF and CycloneDX 1.6 CBOM output.

High-assurance X.509 certificate estate compliance auditor enforcing NSA CNSA 2.0 and NIST FIPS 203/204/205 post-quantum standards with SARIF and CycloneDX 1.6 CBOM export.

- **Area:** Migration & readiness
- **Install:** `npm install git+https://github.com/PQBlocks/cnsa2-pki-auditor`
- **Import:** `import { ... } from '@pqblocks/cnsa2-pki-auditor'`
- **Command line:** `cnsa2-pki-audit`
- **Native dependency:** none
- **Status:** 0.1.0 Stable, Node.js / Browser
- **Docs:** https://pqblocks.github.io/packages/cnsa2-pki-auditor/ · repository https://github.com/PQBlocks/cnsa2-pki-auditor

## Quickstart (executed against the package)

```javascript
import { auditEstate, verifyCertificate } from '@pqblocks/cnsa2-pki-auditor';

// Audit certificate directory or PEM files against CNSA 2.0
const result = await auditEstate({
  paths: [],
  deadline: '2030-12-31',
  scanDate: '2026-11-20',
});

console.log('Audited certificates:', result.summary.total);
console.log('Errors:', result.summary.errors);
```
